definitions.explanation: The view of a landscape or cityscape at night, typically featuring lights.

examples.japanese: {展望台|てんぼうだい}から{夜景|やけい}を{楽|たの}しんだ。
examples.english: We enjoyed the night view from the observation deck.

examples.japanese: {神戸|こうべ}の{夜景|やけい}は{日本|にほん}{三大|さんだい}{夜景|やけい}の{一|ひと}つに{数|かぞ}えられている。
examples.english: The night view of Kobe is counted among Japan's three great night views.

notes:
{夜景|やけい} refers to the visual beauty of a landscape illuminated at night. Composed of {夜|や} (night) + {景|けい} (scenery).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {夜景|やけい}を{見|み}る: to see the night view
- {夜景|やけい}を{楽|たの}しむ: to enjoy the night view
- {夜景|やけい}がきれい: the night view is beautiful
- {夜景|やけい}スポット: night view spot
- {百万|ひゃくまん}ドルの{夜景|やけい}: million-dollar night view

FAMOUS NIGHT VIEWS:
Japan's {三大|さんだい}{夜景|やけい} (three great night views) traditionally include:
- {函館|はこだて} (Hakodate)
- {神戸|こうべ} (Kobe)
- {長崎|ながさき} (Nagasaki)

RELATED WORDS:
- {景色|けしき}: scenery, landscape (general)
- {風景|ふうけい}: scenery (slightly more literary)
- {展望台|てんぼうだい}: observation deck
